```{r writefunction, include=FALSE}
## for implicit (uses dscores in ddply functions)
create_stateTS_I <- function(data_old = data_old, data_new = data_new, 
                           cutoff_year  = 50, cutoff_month = 10){
  data_old$year <- substr(data_old$month, 1, 2)
  data_old$year <- factor(data_old$year, labels = c(2007:2016))
  data_old$year <- as.numeric(as.character(data_old$year))
  data_new$State <- trimws(data_new$STATE)
  
  iat.statechange_old <- ddply(data_old, .(State, year), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_new <- ddply(data_new, .(State, year), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_all <- rbind(iat.statechange_old, iat.statechange_new)
  
  iat.statechange_all <- reshape(iat.statechange_all, idvar = "State", timevar = "year", direction = "wide")
  
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[is.na(iat.statechange_all$State)==FALSE,] # remove the NA state
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[iat.statechange_all$State != "",] # remove the empty level
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[is.na(iat.statechange_all$mean.2007)==FALSE,] # remove the states without continuous values
  rownames(iat.statechange_all) <- iat.statechange_all$State # rename rows and remove State value
  iat.statechange_all$State <- NULL
  colnames(iat.statechange_all) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(iat.statechange_all), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2])) # remove "mean"
  colorder <- as.character(c(2007:2020)) # reorder from 2007:2020
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[,colorder]
  
  # check the frequencies from which these means are computed
  freq.iat_year <- as.data.frame(table(data_old$State, data_old$year))
  freq.iat_year2 <- as.data.frame(table(data_new$State, data_new$year))
  freq.iat_year <- rbind(freq.iat_year, freq.iat_year2)
  colnames(freq.iat_year) <- c("State", "year", "freq")
  freq.iat_year <- reshape(freq.iat_year, idvar = "State", timevar = "year", direction = "wide")
  freq.iat_year <- freq.iat_year[freq.iat_year$State %in% rownames(iat.statechange_all),]
  rownames(freq.iat_year) <- freq.iat_year$State
  colnames(freq.iat_year) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(freq.iat_year), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2]))
  freq.iat_year <- freq.iat_year[,colorder]
  
  # replace any values as needed that fall below a certain cut-off
  replace.iat_year <- as.data.frame(apply(freq.iat_year, c(1,2), function(x) ifelse(x < cutoff_year, NA, x)))
  replace.iat_year <- is.na(replace.iat_year) # does it need to be replaced?
  data.nas_year <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = nrow(freq.iat_year), ncol = ncol(freq.iat_year))
  iat.statechange_all2 <- iat.statechange_all
  iat.statechange_all2[replace.iat_year] <- data.nas_year[replace.iat_year]
  replace.iat_year2 <- vector() # does it have > 25 % of NAs?
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.statechange_all2)[1]){
  replace.iat_year2[i] <- table(is.na(iat.statechange_all2[i,]))[2]
  }
  remove_states_year <- rownames(iat.statechange_all2)[which(replace.iat_year2 > 0.25*dim(iat.statechange_all2)[2])]
  if(length(remove_states_year)>0){ # if any states need to be removed, remove them, if not don't do anything
    iat.statechange_all2 <- iat.statechange_all2[-which(rownames(iat.statechange_all2) %in% remove_states_year),]
  }
  iat.statechange_all3 <- t(iat.statechange_all2)
  iat.stateTS_year <- ts(iat.statechange_all3, start = c(2007), end = c(2020), frequency = 1)
  # impute the missing values 
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.stateTS_year)[2]){
  iat.stateTS_year[,i] <- na_interpolation(as.vector(iat.stateTS_year[,i]))
  }
  # and re-transpose back
  iat.stateTS_year <- as.data.frame(t(iat.stateTS_year))
  colnames(iat.stateTS_year) <- paste("mean.", c(2007:2020), sep = "")
  # add on the additional data vector
  iat.stateTS_year$State <- rownames(iat.stateTS_year)
  iat.stateTS_year <- merge(iat.stateTS_year, state.pol_mar, by = "State")

  # Rank stability
  # compute ranks in 2007 and 2020 to get rank-order stability
  iat.stateTS_year$rank2007 <- rank(iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007)
  iat.stateTS_year$rank2020 <- rank(iat.stateTS_year$mean.2016)
  cor.rank_year <- cor.test(iat.stateTS_year$rank2007, iat.stateTS_year$rank2020, method = "spearman")

  # Raw change
  iat.stateTS_year$rchange <-  iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007 - iat.stateTS_year$mean.2020
  range.raw_year <- range(iat.stateTS_year$rchange)
  mean.raw_year <- mean(iat.stateTS_year$rchange)
  
  # Percent change
  iat.stateTS_year$pchange <-  (iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007 - iat.stateTS_year$mean.2020)/iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007
  range.pch_year <- range(iat.stateTS_year$pchange)
  mean.pch_year <- mean(iat.stateTS_year$pchange)
  
  ### Repeat for monthly changes
  data_new$month.cent <- data_new$month.cent + 156
  iat.statechange_old_month <- ddply(data_old, .(State, month.cent), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_new_month <- ddply(data_new, .(State, month.cent), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_all_month <- rbind(iat.statechange_old_month, iat.statechange_new_month)
  
  iat.statechange_all_month <- reshape(iat.statechange_all_month, idvar = "State", timevar = "month.cent", direction = "wide")
  iat.statechange_all_month <- iat.statechange_all_month[which(iat.statechange_all_month$State %in% rownames(iat.statechange_all)),] # remove the states not in the yearly data
  rownames(iat.statechange_all_month) <- iat.statechange_all_month$State # rename rows and remove State value
  iat.statechange_all_month$State <- NULL
  colnames(iat.statechange_all_month) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(iat.statechange_all_month), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2])) # remove "mean"
  colorder_month <- as.character(c(37:204)) # reorder from month 37:204
  iat.statechange_all_month <- iat.statechange_all_month[,colorder_month]
  
  # check the frequencies from which these means are computed
  freq.iat_month <- as.data.frame(table(data_old$State, data_old$month.cent))
  freq.iat_month2 <- as.data.frame(table(data_new$State, data_new$month.cent))
  freq.iat_month <- rbind(freq.iat_month, freq.iat_month2)
  colnames(freq.iat_month) <- c("State", "month", "freq")
  freq.iat_month <- reshape(freq.iat_month, idvar = "State", timevar = "month", direction = "wide")
  freq.iat_month <- freq.iat_month[freq.iat_month$State %in% rownames(iat.statechange_all_month),]
  rownames(freq.iat_month) <- freq.iat_month$State
  colnames(freq.iat_month) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(freq.iat_month), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2]))
  freq.iat_month <- freq.iat_month[,colorder_month]
  
  # replace any values as needed that fall below a certain cut-off
  replace.iat_month <- as.data.frame(apply(freq.iat_month, c(1,2), function(x) ifelse(x < cutoff_month, NA, x)))
  replace.iat_month <- is.na(replace.iat_month) # does it need to be replaced?
  data.nas_month <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = nrow(freq.iat_month), ncol = ncol(freq.iat_month))
  iat.statechange_all_month2 <- iat.statechange_all_month
  iat.statechange_all_month2[replace.iat_month] <- data.nas_month[replace.iat_month]
  replace.iat_month2 <- vector() # does it have > 25 % of NAs?
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.statechange_all_month2)[1]){
  replace.iat_month2[i] <- table(is.na(iat.statechange_all_month2[i,]))[2]
  }
  remove_states_month <- rownames(iat.statechange_all_month2)[which(replace.iat_month2 > 0.25*dim(iat.statechange_all_month2)[2])]
  if(length(remove_states_month)>0){ # if any states need to be removed, remove them, if not don't do anything
    iat.statechange_all_month2 <- iat.statechange_all_month2[-which(rownames(iat.statechange_all_month2) %in% remove_states_month),]
  }
  iat.statechange_all_month3 <- t(iat.statechange_all_month2)
  iat.stateTS_month <- ts(iat.statechange_all_month3, start = c(2007, 1), end = c(2020, 12), frequency = 12)
  # impute the missing values 
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.stateTS_month)[2]){
  iat.stateTS_month[,i] <- na_interpolation(as.vector(iat.stateTS_month[,i]))
  }
  # and re-transpose back
  iat.stateTS_month <- as.data.frame(t(iat.stateTS_month))
  colnames(iat.stateTS_month) <- paste("mean.", c(1:168), sep = "")
  # add on the additional data vector
  iat.stateTS_month$State <- rownames(iat.stateTS_month)
  iat.stateTS_month <- merge(iat.stateTS_month, state.pol_mar, by = "State")

  # Rank stability
  # compute ranks in first and last months to get rank-order stability
  iat.stateTS_month$rankJan07 <- rank(iat.stateTS_month$mean.1)
  iat.stateTS_month$rankDec20 <- rank(iat.stateTS_month$mean.168)
  cor.rank_month <- cor.test(iat.stateTS_month$rankJan07, iat.stateTS_month$rankDec20, method = "spearman")

  # Raw change
  iat.stateTS_month$rchange <-  iat.stateTS_month$mean.1 - iat.stateTS_month$mean.168
  range.raw_month <- range(iat.stateTS_month$rchange)
  mean.raw_month <- mean(iat.stateTS_month$rchange)
  
  # Percent change
  iat.stateTS_month$pchange <-  (iat.stateTS_month$mean.1 - iat.stateTS_month$mean.168)/iat.stateTS_month$mean.1
  range.pch_month <- range(iat.stateTS_month$pchange)
  mean.pch_month <- mean(iat.stateTS_month$pchange)
  
  # Overall bias
  iat_overalldat <- rbind(data_old[c("State", "dscore", "weightvec")],
                          data_new[c("State", "dscore", "weightvec")])
  iat_overall <- ddply(iat_overalldat, .(State), summarize,
                             meanoverall = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec))
  iat.stateTS_year <- merge(iat.stateTS_year, iat_overall, by = "State")
  iat.stateTS_year$N <- rowSums(freq.iat_year[which(rownames(freq.iat_year) %in% iat.stateTS_year$State),])
  iat.stateTS_month <- merge(iat.stateTS_month, iat_overall, by = "State")
  iat.stateTS_month$N <- rowSums(freq.iat_month[which(rownames(freq.iat_month) %in% iat.stateTS_month$State),])
  
  listresults <- list(cor.rank_year, mean.raw_year, range.raw_year,
                      mean.pch_year, range.pch_year,
                      cor.rank_month, mean.raw_month, range.raw_month,
                      mean.pch_month, range.pch_month)
  
  output <- list(iat.stateTS_year, freq.iat_year,
                 iat.stateTS_month, freq.iat_month,
                 listresults)
  return(output)
}


## for explicit (uses att variables in ddply functions)
create_stateTS_E <- function(data_old = data_old, data_new = data_new, 
                           cutoff_year  = 50, cutoff_month = 10){
  data_old$year <- substr(data_old$month, 1, 2)
  data_old$year <- factor(data_old$year, labels = c(2007:2016))
  data_old$year <- as.numeric(as.character(data_old$year))
  data_new$State <- trimws(data_new$STATE)
  
  iat.statechange_old <- ddply(data_old, .(State, year), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(attnumeric, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_new <- ddply(data_new, .(State, year), summarize, ## takes a little while (about 2 minutes)
                             mean = weighted.mean(attnumeric, weightvec))
  iat.statechange_all <- rbind(iat.statechange_old, iat.statechange_new)
  
  iat.statechange_all <- reshape(iat.statechange_all, idvar = "State", timevar = "year", direction = "wide")
  
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[is.na(iat.statechange_all$State)==FALSE,] # remove the NA state
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[iat.statechange_all$State != "",] # remove the empty level
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[is.na(iat.statechange_all$mean.2007)==FALSE,] # remove the states without continuous values
  rownames(iat.statechange_all) <- iat.statechange_all$State # rename rows and remove State value
  iat.statechange_all$State <- NULL
  colnames(iat.statechange_all) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(iat.statechange_all), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2])) # remove "mean"
  colorder <- as.character(c(2007:2020)) # reorder from 2007:2020
  iat.statechange_all <- iat.statechange_all[,colorder]
  
  # check the frequencies from which these means are computed
  freq.iat_year <- as.data.frame(table(data_old$State, data_old$year))
  freq.iat_year2 <- as.data.frame(table(data_new$State, data_new$year))
  freq.iat_year <- rbind(freq.iat_year, freq.iat_year2)
  colnames(freq.iat_year) <- c("State", "year", "freq")
  freq.iat_year <- reshape(freq.iat_year, idvar = "State", timevar = "year", direction = "wide")
  freq.iat_year <- freq.iat_year[freq.iat_year$State %in% rownames(iat.statechange_all),]
  rownames(freq.iat_year) <- freq.iat_year$State
  colnames(freq.iat_year) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(freq.iat_year), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2]))
  freq.iat_year <- freq.iat_year[,colorder]
  
  # replace any values as needed that fall below a certain cut-off
  replace.iat_year <- as.data.frame(apply(freq.iat_year, c(1,2), function(x) ifelse(x < cutoff_year, NA, x)))
  replace.iat_year <- is.na(replace.iat_year) # does it need to be replaced?
  data.nas_year <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = nrow(freq.iat_year), ncol = ncol(freq.iat_year))
  iat.statechange_all2 <- iat.statechange_all
  iat.statechange_all2[replace.iat_year] <- data.nas_year[replace.iat_year]
  replace.iat_year2 <- vector() # does it have > 25 % of NAs?
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.statechange_all2)[1]){
  replace.iat_year2[i] <- table(is.na(iat.statechange_all2[i,]))[2]
  }
  remove_states_year <- rownames(iat.statechange_all2)[which(replace.iat_year2 > 0.25*dim(iat.statechange_all2)[2])]
  if(length(remove_states_year)>0){ # if any states need to be removed, remove them, if not don't do anything
    iat.statechange_all2 <- iat.statechange_all2[-which(rownames(iat.statechange_all2) %in% remove_states_year),]
  }
  iat.statechange_all3 <- t(iat.statechange_all2)
  iat.stateTS_year <- ts(iat.statechange_all3, start = c(2007), end = c(2020), frequency = 1)
  # impute the missing values 
  for (i in 1:dim(iat.stateTS_year)[2]){
  iat.stateTS_year[,i] <- na_interpolation(as.vector(iat.stateTS_year[,i]))
  }
  # and re-transpose back
  iat.stateTS_year <- as.data.frame(t(iat.stateTS_year))
  colnames(iat.stateTS_year) <- paste("mean.", c(2007:2020), sep = "")
  # add on the additional data vector
  iat.stateTS_year$State <- rownames(iat.stateTS_year)
  iat.stateTS_year <- merge(iat.stateTS_year, state.pol_mar, by = "State")

  # Rank stability
  # compute ranks in 2007 and 2020 to get rank-order stability
  iat.stateTS_year$rank2007 <- rank(iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007)
  iat.stateTS_year$rank2020 <- rank(iat.stateTS_year$mean.2016)
  cor.rank_year <- cor.test(iat.stateTS_year$rank2007, iat.stateTS_year$rank2020, method = "spearman")

  # Raw change
  iat.stateTS_year$rchange <-  iat.stateTS_year$mean.2007 - iat.stateTS_year$mean.2020
  range.raw_year <- range(iat.stateTS_year$rchange)
  mean.raw_year <- mean(iat.stateTS_year$rchange)

  rownames(iat.statechange_all_month) <- iat.statechange_all_month$State # rename rows and remove State value
  iat.statechange_all_month$State <- NULL
  colnames(iat.statechange_all_month) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(iat.statechange_all_month), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2])) # remove "mean"
  colorder_month <- as.character(c(37:204)) # reorder from month 37:204
  iat.statechange_all_month <- iat.statechange_all_month[,colorder_month]
  
  # check the frequencies from which these means are computed
  freq.iat_month <- as.data.frame(table(data_old$State, data_old$month.cent))
  freq.iat_month2 <- as.data.frame(table(data_new$State, data_new$month.cent))
  freq.iat_month <- rbind(freq.iat_month, freq.iat_month2)
  colnames(freq.iat_month) <- c("State", "month", "freq")
  freq.iat_month <- reshape(freq.iat_month, idvar = "State", timevar = "month", direction = "wide")
  freq.iat_month <- freq.iat_month[freq.iat_month$State %in% rownames(iat.statechange_all_month),]
  rownames(freq.iat_month) <- freq.iat_month$State
  colnames(freq.iat_month) <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(freq.iat_month), split='.', fixed=TRUE), function(x) (x[2]))

  }
  iat.statechange_all_month3 <- t(iat.statechange_all_month2)
  iat.stateTS_month <- ts(iat.statechange_all_month3, start = c(2007, 1), end = c(2020, 12), frequency = 12)

  iat_overall <- ddply(iat_overalldat, .(State), summarize,
                             meanoverall = weighted.mean(attnumeric, weightvec))
  iat.stateTS_year <- merge(iat.stateTS_year, iat_overall, by = "State")
  iat.stateTS_year$N <- rowSums(freq.iat_year[which(rownames(freq.iat_year) %in% iat.stateTS_year$State),])
  iat.stateTS_month <- merge(iat.stateTS_month, iat_overall, by = "State")
  iat.stateTS_month$N <- rowSums(freq.iat_month[which(rownames(freq.iat_month) %in% iat.stateTS_month$State),])
  
  listresults <- list(cor.rank_year, mean.raw_year, range.raw_year,
                      mean.pch_year, range.pch_year,
                      cor.rank_month, mean.raw_month, range.raw_month,
                      mean.pch_month, range.pch_month)
  
  output <- list(iat.stateTS_year, freq.iat_year,
                 iat.stateTS_month, freq.iat_month,
                 listresults)
  return(output)
}


```


## Race attitudes - data generation

```{r racedata, echo=FALSE}
## All participants (by State) ----
race_implicit <- create_stateTS_I(data_old = timeseriesRace, data_new = timeseriesRace_NEW,
                           cutoff_year  = 50, cutoff_month = 10)
raceiat_stateyear <- race_implicit[[1]]
raceiat_statemonth <- race_implicit[[3]]
raceiat_freqstatemonth <- race_implicit[[4]]

timeseriesRace$attnumeric <- timeseriesRace$att.center1
race_explicit <- create_stateTS_E(data_old = timeseriesRace, data_new = timeseriesRace_NEW,
                           cutoff_year  = 50, cutoff_month = 10)
raceexp_statemonth_E <- race_explicit[[3]]

## By demographics only (no State) ----
race.imp.consALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Pol.cons, race.Wts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.imp.libALL <- ts(c(race.Wts.Pol.lib, race.Wts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

race.exp.consALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Pol.cons, race.WEts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.exp.libALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Pol.lib, race.WEts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)


## Frequencies of ppts.
monthfreq <- ts(as.vector(c(table(timeseriesRace$month.cent), table(timeseriesRace_NEW$month.cent))),
                start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
monthfreqtrend <- decompose(monthfreq)$trend
```

# DiD models - Race attitudes


``` {r DiD_models_race, echo = FALSE}

## Difference-in-difference for race by ppt politics ----
pptpol_decompdat <- as.data.frame(c(race.trendlib, race.trendcons))
colnames(pptpol_decompdat) <- c("mean")
pptpol_decompdat$libcon <- rep(c("lib", "cons"), each = 168)
pptpol_decompdat$time <- rep(c(1:168), times = 2)

# Only the time range of interest
# April 2016 - April 2017
pptpol_decompdat2 <- pptpol_decompdat[pptpol_decompdat$time < 125 & pptpol_decompdat$time > 112,]


# Model w/ only for 1 year (from 112 - 124) ----
# Shows us the linear increase in the short-term bump.
DiD_race_pptpol <- lm(mean ~ time*libcon, data = pptpol_decompdat2)
summary(DiD_race_pptpol)
lm.beta(DiD_race_pptpol)
plot(allEffects(DiD_race_pptpol))

dat_DiD_race <- as.data.frame(allEffects(DiD_race_pptpol)[[1]][c("fit", "lower", "upper")])
dat_DiD_race$time <- rep(c(1:5), times = 2)
dat_DiD_race$libcon <- rep(c(0,1), each = 5)

plot(y = dat_DiD_race$fit[1:5], x = 1:5, col = "darkred", pch = 19,
     ylim = c(0.23, 0.38), xlim = c(1, 5), type = "l", lwd = 2,
     axes = FALSE, ylab = "IAT D score", xlab = "Time (April 2016 - April 2017)")
box()
axis(2, at = seq(0.2, 0.4, by = 0.02), labels = seq(0.2, 0.4, by = 0.02))
axis(1, at = c(1,3,5), labels = c("April 2016", "September 2016", "April 2017"))
lines(y = dat_DiD_race$fit[6:10], x = 1:5, col = "darkblue", lwd = 2)
polygon(x = c(1,1,5,5), y = c(dat_DiD_race$lower[c(6)],
                              dat_DiD_race$upper[c(6)],
                              dat_DiD_race$upper[c(10)],
                              dat_DiD_race$lower[c(10)]), 
        col = rgb(0,0,255, max = 255, alpha = 100), border = NA)
polygon(x = c(1,1,5,5), y = c(dat_DiD_race$lower[c(1)],
                              dat_DiD_race$upper[c(1)],
                              dat_DiD_race$upper[c(5)],
                              dat_DiD_race$lower[c(5)]), 
        col = rgb(255,0,0, max = 255, alpha = 100), border = NA)
legend("left", c("Conservative Ppt", "Liberal Ppt"), col = c("darkred", "darkblue"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 3, bty = "n", ncol = 2)



## Difference-in-difference models for race by State politics ----

colnames(statepol_decompdat) <- c("mean")

statepol_decompdat$demrep <- relevel(statepol_decompdat$demrep, "rep")
statepol_decompdat$time <- rep(c(1:168), times = 2)

statepol_decompdat2 <- statepol_decompdat[statepol_decompdat$time < 125 & statepol_decompdat$time > 112,]

# Model w/ only for 1 year (from 112 - 124) ----

DiD_race_statepol <- lm(mean ~ time*demrep, data = statepol_decompdat2)
summary(DiD_race_statepol)
lm.beta(DiD_race_statepol)
plot(allEffects(DiD_race_statepol))

dat_state_DiD_race <- as.data.frame(allEffects(DiD_race_statepol)[[1]][c("fit", "lower", "upper")])

axis(1, at = c(1,3,5), labels = c("April 2016", "September 2016", "April 2017"))
lines(y = dat_state_DiD_race$fit[6:10], x = 1:5, col = "darkred", lwd = 2)
```
